resources.string: Makes the remote\'s volume buttons work inside the YouTube TV app. It only reacts to the volume buttons while YouTube is open. It does not read what is on screen, collect any data, or use the internet.
This app is free, as an ongoing charity (sadaqah jariyah) for the soul of the late Ahmed Khalil.\n\nPlease recite Al-Fatiha for his soul.
✅ Enabled: the volume buttons work in YouTube
✅ Enabled. Open YouTube and press a volume button once: the app will check whether your TV needs it.
ℹ️ Your TV does not need this app: the volume buttons already work in YouTube, so the app stays out of the way.
ℹ️ Your TV controls the volume in its own way, which this app cannot help with. The app stays out of the way.
ℹ️ This device controls the volume through the TV or sound system (HDMI-CEC). It does not need this app.
Open YouTube and press a volume button once.

This app uses Android's Accessibility service only to catch the remote's volume buttons while YouTube is open, and change the TV volume.

It does not read the screen, collect data, or connect to the internet.

In the next screen, choose “Volume keys in YouTube” and turn it on.
This TV hides its Accessibility settings. You can enable the app once from a computer with ADB:

On some TVs, the system passes the volume buttons to the open app instead of handling them itself. The YouTube app ignores them, so the volume does not change.\n\nWhile YouTube is open, this app catches the volume buttons and changes the TV volume itself. All other buttons and apps are left as they are.
Dedicated to the soul of the late Ahmed Khalil. May Allah have mercy on him.
